title: Flags-on assist glow rebuilds its path from the UNCAPPED width, diverging from the covenant-capped drawn ribbon
detail: draw_glow_edge's flags-on branches recompute the glow path from uncapped band_world while the drawn ribbon uses link_width_capped, so a clamped bundle's glow bends/apexes diverge from the stroke — breaking this file's own 'follow the drawn path' contract and the PR claim that the assist route glow rides the capped width.
recommended_fix: Derive the glow's path from link_width_capped (or reuse paths[bi] as draw_selection does) so the hover glow follows the drawn ribbon's capped geometry.

title: PR body claims a ±2px stroke-width tolerance; the shipped palcheck gate enforces ±1.0px
detail: The golden-inventory section still states the pre-review ±2px tolerance; the shipped gate is ±1.0px (the review section records the 2.0→1.0 tightening). Stale internal contradiction in the claims under review.
recommended_fix: Correct the inventory line to ±1px (or reference the tightened tolerance) so the PR body matches the shipped gate.
